budget.primary_score_budget_basis: 1000 allocated episode slots, independent of how many were actually launched

method_parameters.scope_note: one MethodConfig is used for all three methods; parameters unused by a method are inert for it

stable_criterion.not_applicable_policy: planned n != 30 or unfinished run -> not_applicable with stable = null

primary_metric.name: Stable Neighborhood Yield
primary_metric.definition: exact maximum number of pairwise non-overlapping six-dimensional local neighbourhoods among the candidates that pass the Final Audit stability criterion

reporting.primary_success_criterion: effect size with uncertainty; p-values are not the primary criterion

provenance.note: Seeds 1-5 were produced under the first driver commit; seeds 6-20 under the orchestration-fix commit. The three formal commits differ only in scripts/run_v03_formal.py.
